messages.subject: Notice of Proposal - Maple Court Care Home
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Pryce,

Please find attached a Notice of Proposal to impose conditions on Ashbourne Healthcare Group Limited's registration in respect of Maple Court Care Home. The provider has 28 days from the date of the notice (by 22 May 2025) to make written representations.

Yours sincerely,
Robert Adeyemi
Head of Inspection (Adult Social Care, East of England)
Care Quality Commission

messages.subject: FW: Notice of Proposal - Maple Court Care Home
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom - the Notice of Proposal has landed. Two conditions: monthly medicines-governance reporting (fine) and no new admissions without CQC agreement (not fine). Can we get representations underway? Forwarding the notice.

Daniel
